main_text.p: iurando fanxissent, faciendo. Damnatis tantum Arei, & Alcibiadis, quæ nuper facta erat, sublata est. Huc usque ipsa verba Livii. Appius ex Peloponnefo in Cretam vicinam trajecit cum collegis, & res ibi turbatas inter Gortynios & Cnossios, civitates insulæ maximas, arbiter delectus composuit, Romamque rediit, haud satis propitius Achæis, in-primis infensus partibus Philopœmenis & Lycortæ. Paulo post Romam venere legationes variæ regum & populorum, pleræque omnes mandatis instructæ à suis contra Philippum Macedonem: qui eodem tunc misit Demetrium fi-lium suum, quem Romanis, apud quos obses fuerat, carum esse haud ignorabat, pro sese responsurum. Macedoni-cis rebus in curia Romana pro tempore præsenti expeditis, & multis delictis ob Demetrium Philippo condonatis (quod testimonium à senatu ei perhibitum, & patri denunciatum optimo juveni in invidiam exitialem vertit) Lacedæmo-niorum legati, in factiones quatuor tunc divisi, ad exponenda mandata sua in senatum vocati, cum varietate man-datorum turbarent senatus mentes majoribus negociis intentas, dati sunt iis viri tres rerum Græciæ cumprimis periti ob legationes priores, & res illic actas:

page.notes: Catchword "actas:" read from a faint scan; the first letter may be æ or a, and the word could be misread. Show-through at lower left ("nes", "ncz bd sau", "nes pq") was not transcribed. Printed text is in italic for the opening sentence, as shown. Possible misreading of "fanxissent" (printed with long s, read as ff). No printing errors corrected.
